opportunity: Allocation of 1.2% of personal income tax (GPM) to support receivers (FR0512 request)
funder: State Tax Inspectorate (VMI), Lithuania
what: Residents can assign up to 1.2% of their paid personal income tax to one or more support receivers by filing form FR0512 electronically (EDS / Mano VMI). For 2025 income the window was 1 January - 4 May 2026; the statutory reference date is 1 May of the year following the tax year.
amount: Up to 1.2% of each resident's paid income tax (plus separate up to 0.6% for political organisations and up to 0.6% for trade unions)
role: Applicants: NGOs with the NGO mark (nevyriausybines organizacijos zyma) and support receiver status (paramos gavejo statusas) in the Register of Legal Entities (JAR, Registru centras); art creators registered as support receivers; listed Lithuanian communities abroad; trade unions for the 0.6% share
why: Since 1 January 2025 only NGOs and art creators can receive the 1.2%; budgetary institutions (e.g. state schools) no longer can. Receiver must hold support receiver status and the NGO mark on 1 May of the year after the tax year and on the transfer day; transfers are refused if the NGO has not filed financial statements and activity report or does not publish project information on its website. Organisations must register a bank account for the GPM share via Mano VMI. Support receiver status is requested from Registru centras (form JAR-PGS or self-service). Paper requests are not accepted.
rule: Rolling, annual cycle: residents file FR0512 from 1 January to the 1 May deadline (moved to next working day; 2026 window 1 January - 4 May 2026 for 2025 income). Requests can be corrected until 30 June. VMI page itself is behind a Cloudflare challenge; wording verified via Web Archive snapshots of 2026-04-21 and 2026-06-15.
